av_event.what: His half-smile drops for a moment and he looks down and away from the screen for two or three seconds, jaw tightening slightly, before looking back at the camera with a neutral face.

text:
A: Alright, mate! Can you hear me okay?
B: Yeah. Alright. I'm Craig.
A: Jago. Last call of the lot, I think, isn't it? How you finding it?
B: Yeah, alright. Bit weird, talking to strangers for three minutes.
A: It is a bit, yeah. Like speed dating but nobody's allowed to fancy anyone. I'm down in Truro, Cornwall. Where are you?
B: Swindon.
A: Swindon, nice. Have you ever been down Cornwall?
B: Newquay. Stag do. Don't remember a lot of it, to be fair.
A: Ha, classic. I did a whole summer season at a surf hostel in Newquay, and honestly the stag dos were the best and worst bit of the job. Every Friday, a minibus of lads in matching T-shirts, someone dressed as a banana, and by Sunday someone's lost a shoe on Fistral beach. No offence, like.
B: None taken. We were probably one of them.
A: [laughs] Was there a banana?
B: Mankini, I think.
A: Even worse. What do you do then, Craig?
B: Quality inspection. Engineering firm. I run a CMM, measuring machine, checking parts are in tolerance.
A: Oh, so properly precise. I'm the opposite, I just point a camera and hope. Is that a gaming headset behind you? Are you a gamer?
B: Bit, yeah. Racing sims mostly. Some shooters. Mic off.
A: Mic off, respect. The lads I play with just scream at each other. Do you play any actual football? I do five-a-side on a Wednesday.
B: Used to. In my twenties. Sort of drifted off it.
A: Yeah, ours nearly went the same way, to be fair. It's lads from my sixth form, and every year someone moves to London or does their knee in, and we're down to like six of us now with a rotating keeper. Last week our keeper turned up in jeans because he'd come straight from a date. Still saved a penalty, mind.
B: Yeah. That's how ours went. Everyone got girlfriends, then houses, then kids.
A: Yeah, that's the dream that kills five-a-side. Do you do a pub quiz or anything? I'm the film and music round guy at ours.
B: Once a month. With two mates from college. I do sport and cars.
A: Mate, we'd be a proper team then. You do sport, I do films, we just need someone for geography.
B: Yeah. Geography's always where we lose it.
A: Same! Capital cities, I'm useless. So what's work been like this week, busy?
B: Proper busy. Had to redo a whole batch because a fixture was set up wrong. Every part out by the same amount.
A: Oh no, that's like when I filmed a whole interview with the mic on mute. Forty minutes of an old boy talking about his rowing days and I got nothing. Just a lovely silent film of him waving his arms about.
B: [laughs] Did you redo it?
A: Yeah, he did it again, even better, to be fair. Told the stories bigger second time round. Bit like me.
B: Fair enough.
A: What do you reckon to this study then? Doing it for the science?
B: Money, mostly, to be honest. Bit extra towards a deposit.
A: Ha, honest. Same, saving for a new lens. Don't tell the researchers we—
